description: Resolve a company domain or name to its LinkedIn company URL, with a 0-100 confidence_score, social links, and optional firmographics from search snippets, as a flat, Clay-ready JSON row. A URL is returned only when verified: the company homepage links it, or its name is identical to the name the company site declares or the company_name you pass; otherwise linkedin_company_url is null and verification says why. No request is sent to LinkedIn. Provide at least one of company_domain or company_name. Use this when the LinkedIn company URL is the answer you need; use resolve_company_identity instead to cross-check a name, domain, and LinkedIn URL you already hold and get a canonical identity with conflicts flagged. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: Bare company domain, e.g. stripe.com. Required if company_name is not provided.

company_name.description: Company name. Required if company_domain is not provided.

includeFirmographics.description: When "true", also reads employee count, industry, HQ, follower count and description from search result snippets about the LinkedIn company page. No request is sent to LinkedIn. Fields no snippet states stay null. Off by default because it can add a search. Sent as a string for Clay compatibility.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

minConfidenceScore.description: A LinkedIn page is returned only when its match score is at least this value, 0 to 100. Default "70". Raise it for fewer, surer answers; lower it for more answers and more wrong ones. Sent as a string for Clay compatibility.

skipCache.description: When "false", the default, a successful resolution is cached for 7 days and reused. Set "true" to force a fresh resolution. Sent as a string for Clay compatibility.

name: resolve_linkedin_url
title: Resolve LinkedIn URL
